For a 50-person Indian company, the strongest purchase-ready shortlist today is:

Option	Cost model	Trade-off	Best fit
ITILITE	₹0 platform fee; $10/trip, or $7 with prepaid wallet	Most transparent pricing; airline/hotel penalties still apply. 24/7 human support included. 
Itilite
+1
	Best if predictable TMC cost matters
MMT myBiz	Custom service fee + GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply	Strong Indian inventory, GST invoices and special fares; cancellation ultimately depends on fare/provider. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Best for India-heavy travel
FCM Travel India	Custom quote	Strongest managed-TMC structure: dedicated account management, 24/7 support, travel governance and negotiated supplier programmes. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Best for high-touch managed travel
What I'd put in the PO/RFP

Before paying, require the vendor to state in writing:

All-in booking/service fee, including GST and payment fees

Cancellation/reissue fees separate from airline/hotel penalties

Refund processing timeline

24/7 support response and resolution SLA

Named account manager

Credit period and deposit/prepaid requirements

Unused-ticket/credit management

No minimum-spend or termination penalty

Implementation/integration fees

Value decision: I’d take ITILITE's commercial proposal as the benchmark, then ask MMT and FCM to beat it on total annual cost + service SLA, rather than comparing headline booking prices alone. ITILITE explicitly states no minimum commitment, no extra modification/support fees and free onboarding. 
Itilite
